title: A policy holds a call to its strictest verdict: the workflow's exception first, never the loosest, and an operation only stricter
goal: strictest() lets deny stand over approval over allow; capabilityVerdict() asks a workflow's own exception first, then the resource's rule for the capability, then its default, then allow, skipping anything that is not a verdict; undeclaredVerdict() holds a call that names no capability to the strictest verdict over everything the resource provides, never the loosest; operationOf() calls a tool a read only when its server vouches for it; operationVerdict() answers for a read or a write; and a call held to the strictest of its capability verdict and its operation's rule is only ever made stricter by the operation
reproduce: every failing check names the policy, the capability or capabilities, the workflow and the tool it asked about, the verdict the contract expects and the one that came back; the probe imports the subject's own policy module and answers in its own process
